title: Microsprint hitlist — Priya's outreach plan (2026-03-13)
content:
Goal: 3 qualified discovery meetings booked today. Focus accounts: mid-market fintech (APAC expansion), two ecommerce platforms, one ML infra team.

Timebox plan (microsprints):
- 09:00–09:25 (25m): Call blitz #1 — quick qualification, aim to leave 1 voicemail + 6 live connects.
- 09:30–09:50 (20m): Send tailored follow-up emails for any warm opens + update SFDC fields (stage, last_touch, next_action).
- 10:00–10:25 (25m): Call blitz #2 — deeper discovery for warm leads from last week.
- 14:00–14:30 (30m): Afternoon nurture — LinkedIn messages, sequence step 3, personal note to champions.
- 16:00–16:20 (20m): Admin wrap — update pipeline, set reminders, log call notes.

Quick heuristics to use on calls:
- If mention latency/cost concerns -> pitch Redwood Optimize + dedicated pools as path to predictable unit economics.
- If they use on-prem or have compliance reqs -> surface Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) and offer a technical intro with solutions eng.
- If they ask about scale/SLAs -> highlight Dedicated capacity + autoscale options and recent SLA numbers (share internal doc later).

Today call list (order = priority):
1) Hana Park (CTO) — VelaPay (mid-market fintech) — last touch 2026-03-02 email (product interest). Goal: qualify if they're evaluating vendors for APAC rollout; book 30m tech+prod sync. Quick script: "Hana, Priya from Redwood — saw your note about APAC rollout. Are latency/cost or data residency the biggest blockers?"
   - if no answer: voicemail template: "Hana, Priya Shah at Redwood Inference. We help teams shrink per-token cost while hitting latency SLOs — let's pick 15m to see if there's fit. My calendar: redwood.com/priya"
   - next action: send 1-pager + ROI calc if opens.
2) Marcus Lee (Head of ML Infra) — ShopFront (ecommerce) — last touch 2026-03-08 demo. Goal: confirm POC scope and timeline.
   - prep: have benchmark numbers for model A vs quantized variant; call to align on seq lengths.
   - note: he cares about KV cache and 95thpct latency.
3) Rina Sharma (Product Lead) — ClearCart (ecommerce startup) — inbound trial started 2026-03-05. Goal: surface quick wins and push for pilot kickoff.
   - script: "Rina, quick check — are you seeing expected latency at 512 tokens? If yes, we can enable batching suggestions to cut cost."
4) Tomasz Kowalski (VP Eng) — AtlasML (ML platform) — cold outbound (LinkedIn liked). Goal: warm intro + discovery for integrations.
   - tactic: mention open-source model support and consistent API across hosted/private.
5) Samira Nadeem (Director AI) — HealthX (regulated healthcare). Goal: set intro with security lead for Private deployment discussion.
   - prep: KMS/HSM questions ready, ask about audit log requirements.

Email snippets (short, skimmable):
- Subject: Quick question on APAC inference latency
  Body: "Hi Hana — quick one: as you plan APAC rollout, is predictable latency or cost the bigger constraint? We recently helped a fintech cut per-token spend by ~40% while hitting 50ms p95 — happy to share numbers. — Priya"

- Subject: Pilot next steps — POA for ShopFront
  Body: "Marcus — thanks for the demo last week. For the POC I suggest: (1) 2-week perf run on model X with KV caching; (2) compare quantized v1 vs float baseline; (3) weekly sync. Want me to draft the POA?"

Call tactics / scripts (short bullets):
- Opening: 20s intro, context (why I'm calling), 1 question about priority.
- Qualification: "What's your SLO for tail latency? Who owns infra vs product decisions?"
- Closing ask: get a specific next-step owner + time window ("15–30m next week for tech sync?").

Voicemail short: "Hi [Name], Priya Shah at Redwood Inference — we're helping teams lower inference cost while keeping latency predictable. If budget/latency are on your roadmap, I'd love 15 minutes. My calendar: redwood.com/priya — thanks."

Admin todo (after each microsprint):
- log call note in SFDC: outcome, next_action, probability, ask owner.
- update sequence status in Outreach: reply/open/bounced.
- if interest: create playbook doc link in account folder and tag SE.

Open questions / blockers:
- Hana: need APAC region cost sheet (ask Noah for numbers).
- Marcus: wants kernel-level latency numbers for model X — ask eng SE Zeke for available benchmarks.
- HealthX: compliance packet is outdated (legal doc needs refresh). Flag to GTM compliance.

Notes to self:
- Keep calls <8 minutes unless technical deep dive scheduled.
- If a champion mentions "cost" but not SLA, lead with Optimize suggestions (batching + quantization).
- After any booked demo, send a short agenda within 1 hour.

Wins to log this week:
- Booked 2 demos (ShopFront + VelaPay), pushed 1 POC to pilot phase.

End of microsprint — breathe, refill water, 2-min stand stretch.
